title: Insect Eyes
body:
Syntax: perform insect eyes <target>

Description: Reflects the victim's own normal attack sequence as mental damage, including extra strikes. Mental damage scales with the opponent's own offensive strength. Usable with any chakra nature. Base damage: 301-357. Unlocks at level 50. Costs 43 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 9 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
